summary: Tested IT Niche landing page redesign (single-page marketing site). Backend /api/ scaffolding healthy (3/3 pytest passing). Frontend: all 42 data-testids present, 5 primary CTAs correctly point to https://www.itniche.com with target=_blank and rel=noopener, all 4 nav anchors (#pricing, #what-drives-cost, #process, #why-us) correct, anchor scroll works, hero/workspace/infographic images load (workspace is lazy-loaded — loads correctly when scrolled into view, not a bug), no horizontal scroll at 375px or 1280px, no console errors. 67/68 frontend assertions passed (the 1 'fail' was the false-positive lazy-load check, re-verified passing).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — consider lifespan handlers (FastAPI >=0.93). Non-blocking.
No automated test that verifies external link CTAs actually open new tab (covered by attribute checks instead, which is sufficient per requirements).
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_landing_smoke status_check row during persistence test (acceptable, schema is append-only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure marketing landing page; no auth, no user forms. Only backend endpoints are /api/ (returns Hello World) and /api/status (GET/POST). All CTAs are external links to itniche.com. The workspace-image in WhyUs section uses loading='lazy' — when testing image load, scroll it into view first or expect false on initial above-the-fold check.
